title.narrative: In 2024, BiH advanced equity in social protection with child benefit improvements, disability reforms, and shock-responsive models. Costed strategies emphasized resilience and poverty reduction, and pathfinder designation under the Global Accelerator on Jobs and Social Protection reinforced BiH’s commitment to inclusive growth and progressive social policies.
